security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Notebooks in the Zim wiki format, with encrypted notebooks
bundle.longDescription: Notebooks in the Zim wiki format, edited as in Zim, with live formatting, tables, a journal and tags, and encrypted notebooks that stay encrypted on the device. The same app as the web version, installed.
